title: "DAG"
format: html

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggdag)
library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_dag())
```


```{r}
# Define the DAG
EW_YR_dag<- dagify(Year ~ SST,
                   ENSO ~ SST,
                   ExtremeEvents ~ SST,
                   ExtremeEvents ~ Year)

#plot DAG using the ggdag function
ggdag(EW_YR_dag)
```
